$comment: Machine-readable facts for the herdr-sidebar repository. Verified by tools/check_knowledge_docs.py (also run from tests/test_knowledge_docs.py). Update inspected_ref/verified_date and every claim you re-check.

modules.role: Platform selection and logical manifest entry ids
POSIX locks, sockets, terminal and font setup
Windows locks, named pipes, terminal and font registrations
Read-only saved conversation popup; wraps and scrolls without waking agents
Reads exact saved requests and persists title context across hibernation
Publishes display rows, headings and tree prefixes; diffs against reported tokens
Native exact-session names for Codex, Claude and Pi from local metadata (512 KiB tail scan)
One newline-delimited JSON request over the platform API transport; 2 s timeout, 4 MiB reply cap
Single scheduler: quiet-period deadlines plus optional animation frames; also spawns itself
Pure quiet-period state machine returning dimmed workspaces and the next deadline
Braille loader styles, frame cache and per-frame token patch
Whole-workspace activity ordering plus the Herdr agent-view override
User-owned preferences: defaults, validation, comment-preserving patch, atomic save
Dependency-free platform terminal settings popup; applies changes synchronously
Herdr binary discovery, CLI wrapper, icon mode selection, provider logo maps
TOML surgery: layout merge, Spaces dimming rows, settings shortcut, Ghostty mapping
install/uninstall/doctor with a backup record and a changed-since-install guard

tests.role: Platform popup routing and read-only scrolling with native keys
Real platform locks, wake channel, detached processes and API transport
Platform launchers, entry ids and mirrored hooks
Settings popup inputs, save and cancel behavior
Platform paths, shortcut preservation and Windows font restoration
Refresh-to-title-to-sleep integration, opt-in, manual rename race and metadata preservation
Exact conversation identity, saved context, hibernation, and conservative tab title ownership

tests.locks: Row tree, group gap, dim variants, task-label fallbacks, compact single-tab rows
Heading follows the first live agent; a former heading is cleared
Codex/Claude/Pi native title precedence and rejection of weak names
Quiet-period boundary, working resets, corrupt/backwards state
Workspace activity order, native ties, owner-scoped view override
Frame styles stay in one braille cell; frame writes touch only the working token
Icon mode fallbacks, deleted-binary suffix, hs_title is never published
Comment-preserving patch, concurrent-edit refusal, shortcut claim
Layout merge idempotence, unsupported forms refused, change guard
Codepoint order, committed fonts equal a fresh build, fixed pitch
Standard/short selection removes exactly one cell
Renamed panes prefix the task; already-prefixed labels are untouched
AGY mark and label; Ghostty mapping upgrade is single-line and idempotent
This knowledge set: links, anchors, placeholders and registry facts

tools.role: Deterministic base font from font/codepoints.toml + assets/svg (output dist/HerdrHarnessLogos-Regular.ttf)
Derives the shipped font: enlarges claude/codex/agy/hermes/kimchi/pi, renames the family (output dist/HerdrSidebarLogos-Regular.ttf)
Validates knowledge-doc links, anchors, placeholders and registry facts

preferences.note: The config key itself is named in no user-facing doc; the popup shows minutes and stores seconds.

tokens.name: hs_parked
tokens.meaning: Saved sleeping conversation titles in Spaces, without an agent anchor

tokens.name: hs_group
tokens.meaning: Workspace heading on its first agent

tokens.name: hs_group_dim
tokens.meaning: Dimmed workspace heading for quiet workspaces

tokens.name: hs_tab
tokens.meaning: Tab heading on its first agent, when the workspace has more than one actual tab

tokens.name: hs_tab_dim
tokens.meaning: Dimmed tab heading

tokens.name: hs_logo
tokens.meaning: Indentation, optional branch and provider mark for unfocused agent rows

tokens.name: hs_logo_dim
tokens.meaning: Dimmed variant of hs_logo

tokens.name: hs_logo_focus
tokens.meaning: Retired focus-bar token, always cleared by the runtime
tokens.note: Selected rows keep the regular icon and prefix; no layout row consumes this token.

tokens.name: hs_gap
tokens.meaning: Braille blank row after the last agent of a workspace

tokens.name: hs_terminals
tokens.meaning: Names of terminal-only tabs in the workspace

tokens.name: hs_workspace_rank
tokens.meaning: Hidden 12-digit rank used by the activity agent-view sort

tokens.name: hs_title
tokens.meaning: User-owned title override; read but never written or cleared

tokens.name: hs_space
tokens.meaning: Workspace label in Spaces while the workspace is active

tokens.name: hs_space_dim
tokens.meaning: Workspace label in Spaces while the workspace is quiet

tokens.name: hs_working
tokens.meaning: Working status mark plus task label (animated when loaders are on)

tokens.name: hs_working_dim
tokens.meaning: Dimmed working row

tokens.name: hs_blocked
tokens.meaning: Blocked status mark plus task label

tokens.name: hs_blocked_dim
tokens.meaning: Dimmed blocked row (gray, not red)

tokens.name: hs_done
tokens.meaning: Done status mark plus task label

tokens.name: hs_done_dim
tokens.meaning: Dimmed done row (gray, not green)

tokens.name: hs_idle
tokens.meaning: Idle status mark plus task label

tokens.name: hs_idle_dim
tokens.meaning: Dimmed idle row

tokens.name: hs_unknown
tokens.meaning: Unknown status mark plus task label

tokens.name: hs_unknown_dim
tokens.meaning: Dimmed unknown row

tokens.name: hs_logo_kimchi
tokens.meaning: hs_logo for a bright Kimchi row, coloured #FF521D by the default rows

env.name: APPDATA
env.role: Windows Herdr config and session root

env.name: LOCALAPPDATA
env.role: Windows plugin state, per-user font and terminal settings root

env.name: WINDIR
env.role: Windows system font directory for machine registrations

env.name: HERDR_CONTEXT_TAB_ID
env.role: Selected tab captured before opening the saved-context popup

env.name: HERDR_SIDEBAR_HIBERNATE_STATE
env.role: Optional Hibernate state.json override for isolated sessions

env.name: HERDR_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR
env.role: Plugin state dir (locks, activity.json, view.json, deadline.log); required to run

env.name: HERDR_PLUGIN_CONFIG_DIR
env.role: Plugin config dir holding the preferences config.toml

env.name: HERDR_PLUGIN_ID
env.role: Metadata source suffix; defaults to the plugin id

env.name: HERDR_SOCKET_PATH
env.role: Herdr server socket for direct IPC

env.name: HERDR_BIN_PATH
env.role: Herdr binary path; a ' (deleted)' suffix is stripped

env.name: HERDR_ENV
env.role: Setup refuses to run unless it is 1

env.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
env.role: Base for default Herdr and Ghostty config paths

managed_paths.name: plugin-preferences
managed_paths.written: icons preference only; user_editable in the backup record

managed_paths.name: font
managed_paths.written: byte copy of the shipped font; skipped with --text

exit_codes.1: setup error or a doctor check needing attention

setup_cli.backup_record: <state dir>/install.json with files[{before, installed_sha256, user_editable?}] and created_link; renamed to uninstalled.json after removal
setup_cli.guard: install and uninstall refuse to overwrite managed files whose bytes changed since installation; --dry-run returns before the guard

evidence.claim: The plugin publishes only changed hs_* keys per pane and workspace and never writes hs_title or other plugins' tokens
The shipped layout consumes every published token except hs_logo_focus and hs_workspace_rank
evidence.next: Confirm the rendered focused row in an isolated session

evidence.claim: The focused-row token was never added to the layout: all three focus commits touched only sidebar.py
evidence.source: git show --stat ab9b806 c7f5097 4352afa; git log -S hs_logo_focus -- sidebar-layout.toml (empty)
evidence.next: Decide whether to add the row (owner decision)

evidence.claim: Herdr 0.8.2 is installed and the manifest requires 0.8.2+
The bundled fonts are byte-reproducible from tracked sources
evidence.source: sha256 of dist/*.ttf vs a rebuild in the pinned fonttools environment; tests/test_font.py:72-84; CI git diff --exit-code -- dist/

evidence.claim: Animation runs at 8 fps and touches only hs_working/hs_working_dim with a single registry lookup per frame
evidence.next: Re-measure cost at 8 fps (the table in docs/architecture.md is a 4 fps baseline)

evidence.claim: The installer records a backup before writing and refuses to overwrite files edited since installation
evidence.next: Exercise install/doctor/uninstall in a scratch config root

evidence.claim: The live install record's config hash differs from the current Herdr config, so install and uninstall would refuse today
evidence.next: Reconcile the live config with its backup, then re-run install and doctor

evidence.claim: test_activity_titles covers Codex/Claude/Pi precedence, but no test covers refresh(), ipc.call, deadline.run or the settings popup
evidence.next: Add a scratch harness that stubs run_herdr/ipc.call and asserts refresh() argv

evidence.claim: The README settings table omits pane_names and no user doc names inactive_after_seconds
docs/architecture.md documents the icon font range as U+E1A0-U+E1A8 (nine marks) while the code, font data and setup docs use ten through U+E1A9
Pi is handled as a title source but has no icon or text label, so Pi rows show the generic mark
evidence.next: Check the agent id Herdr reports for Pi, then add a mark or document the fallback

evidence.claim: Coarse platform support is documented but macOS live rendering was never verified; CI runs unit tests only
evidence.next: Run install/doctor and capture the sidebar on macOS

evidence.claim: The performance table in docs/architecture.md is an explicitly historical 4 fps baseline, not a measurement of the current 8 fps styles
The animated performance and many-agent cost are unmeasured for the current styles, and Python 3.11 has no local run
evidence.source: no benchmark artifact in the repo; local interpreters are 3.12.3
evidence.next: Run the CI matrix locally via uv or docker for 3.11, and re-measure with several working agents
